newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IPALCO Enterprises estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IPALCO Enterprises estimates raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it raised its earnings estimate for IPALCO Enterprises Inc in 1997 to $2.26 from $2.10 and the estimate for 1998 to $2.46 from $2.20.
-- EVEREN said the changes reflect a recapitalization plan announced last month, which includes a "Dutch auction" calling for IPALCO to repurchase 12 million shares at $32 each.
-- IPALCO's five-year dividend growth rate was also raised to 6.6 percent from 3.4 percent, EVEREN said.
-- IPALCO is a multi-state energy holding copmany.
-- Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at 31-1/8.
